newsitem.title: EU: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 296 OF NOVEMBER 21, 1996.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 296 OF NOVEMBER 21, 1996.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)
COUNCIL DIRECTIVE 96/62/EC of 27 September 1996 on ambient air quality assessment and management
COUNCIL REGULATION (EC) No 2222/96 of 18 November 1996 amending Regulation (EEC) No 805/68 on the common organization of the market in beef and veal
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 2221/96 of 20 November 1996 fixing the agricultural conversion rates
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 2220/96 of 20 November 1996 establishing the standard import values for determining the entry price of certain fruit and vegetables
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 2219/96 of 20 November 1996 amending representative prices and additional duties for the import of certain products in the sugar sector
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 2218/96 of 20 November 1996 fixing the import duties in the rice sector
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 2217/96 of 20 November 1996 re-establishing the preferential customs duty on imports of multiflorous (spray) carnations originating in Israel
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 2216/96 of 20 November 1996 fixing the export refunds on milk and milk products
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 2215/96 of 20 November 1996 providing for derogating measures in respect of 'Gluhwein'
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 2214/96 of 20 November 1996 concerning harmonized indices of consumer prices: transmission and dissemination of sub-indices of the HICP (Text with EEA relevance)
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 2213/96 of 20 November 1996 fixing the representative prices and the additional import duties for molasses in the sugar sector

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 2212/96 of 20 November 1996 fixing the maximum export refund for white sugar for the 16th partial invitation to tender issued within the framework of the standing invitation to tender provided for in Regulation (EC) No 1464/96
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 2211/96 of 20 November 1996 fixing the export refunds on white sugar and raw sugar exported in its unaltered state

COUNCIL REGULATION (EC) No 2210/96 of 14 November 1996 amending Regulation (EC) No 3076/95 allocating, for 1996, certain catch quotas between Member States for vessels fishing in the Norwegian exclusive economic zone and the fishing zone around Jan Mayen END OF DOCUMENT.
